spans.s:
(औ) औरभ r. 1st cl. (रभते) or more usually (आरभते)
To begin, to make a beginning, to begin willingly, &c.
2 To be pleased with.
(इ) रभि r. 1st cl. (रंभते)
To sound.
With परि prefixed,
To embrace.

m. (-सः)
1 Speed, velocity.
2 Joy, delight.
3 Consideration of causes and events, or the past and future.
4 Regret, sorrow for something lost or absent.
E.
रभ to begin, असच् Uṇādi aff.
